name: Stellar Global Supplies — Cloudflare Monitor
description: Full CF observability: traffic, workers, builds, errors, usage, logs. Events: CloudflareCronSummary, CloudflareWorkerMetric, CloudflareSiteMetric, CloudflarePagesBuild, CloudflareAccountUsage. Logs: CloudflareWorkerLog (NR Logs).

pages.name: 📊 Overview
pages.description: Master at-a-glance across all apps and workers — 24hr window

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(totalApps) AS 'Apps' FROM CloudflareCronSummary SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(totalWorkers) AS 'Workers' FROM CloudflareCronSummary SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(invocations) AS 'Invocations' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(requests) AS 'Requests' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(uniqueVisitors) AS 'Visitors' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(errors) / sum(invocations) * 100 AS 'Error Rate %' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric SINCE 24 hours ago

widgets.title: Site Requests Over Time — All Apps

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(requests) FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago

widgets.title: Worker Invocations Over Time — By App

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(invocations) FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric FACET appName TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(errors) / sum(invocations) * 100 AS 'Error %' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(http5xx) FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago

widgets.title: Cron Health — Events Pushed Per Run

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(totalLogsPushed) AS 'Events', latest(runDurationMs) AS 'Run ms' FROM CloudflareCronSummary TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT timestamp, runStatus, runDurationMs, totalLogsPushed, totalWorkerLogs, totalErrors, totalInvocations, totalRequests FROM CloudflareCronSummary SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 20
SELECT uniqueCount(workerName) AS 'Workers' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(invocations) AS 'Invocations' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(errors) AS 'Errors' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(subrequests) AS 'Subrequests' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(totalWorkerLogs) AS 'Log Lines' FROM CloudflareCronSummary SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(totalLogsPushed) AS 'Events Sent' FROM CloudflareCronSummary SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(appName) AS 'App', sum(invocations) AS 'Invocations', sum(errors) AS 'Errors', latest(errorRate) AS 'Error %', latest(cpuTimeP50Ms) AS 'CPU p50ms', latest(cpuTimeP99Ms) AS 'CPU p99ms', sum(subrequests) AS 'Subrequests' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric FACET workerName SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 50
SELECT sum(errors) AS 'Errors' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric FACET workerName SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 10
SELECT max(cpuTimeP99Ms) AS 'CPU p99ms' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric FACET workerName SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 20
SELECT sum(invocations) FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(invocations) FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric FACET workerName TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(errors) FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric FACET workerName TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago

pages.name: 🌐 App Traffic
pages.description: CF Pages traffic per app — requests, visitors, cache, HTTP status — 24hr

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(requests) AS 'Requests' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(uniqueVisitors) AS 'Visitors' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(pageViews) AS 'Page Views' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(cachedRequests) / sum(requests) * 100 AS 'Cache Hit %' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(http4xx) AS '4xx' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(http5xx) AS '5xx' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(domain) AS 'Domain', sum(requests) AS 'Requests', sum(uniqueVisitors) AS 'Visitors', sum(pageViews) AS 'Views', sum(cachedRequests) AS 'Cached', sum(http2xx) AS '2xx', sum(http4xx) AS '4xx', sum(http5xx) AS '5xx', latest(cacheHitRate) AS 'Cache %', latest(errorRate5xx) AS '5xx %' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 20
SELECT sum(requests) FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(http2xx) AS '2xx OK', sum(http3xx) AS '3xx Redirect', sum(http4xx) AS '4xx Client Error', sum(http5xx) AS '5xx Server Error' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(uniqueVisitors) AS 'Visitors' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(cacheHitRate) AS 'Cache Hit %' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(requests) FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(uniqueVisitors) FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(http4xx) FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(http5xx) FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago

pages.name: 🏗️ Pages Builds
pages.description: CF Pages build health — success/fail, duration, per project — 7 day

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(totalBuilds) AS 'Builds' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT sum(successBuilds) AS 'Success' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT sum(failedBuilds) AS 'Failed' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT sum(cancelledBuilds) AS 'Cancelled' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT average(buildDurationMs) AS 'Avg Build ms' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT sum(successBuilds) / sum(totalBuilds) * 100 AS 'Success %' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild SINCE 7 days ago

SELECT sum(totalBuilds) AS 'Total', sum(successBuilds) AS 'Success', sum(failedBuilds) AS 'Failed', sum(cancelledBuilds) AS 'Cancelled', average(buildDurationMs) AS 'Avg ms', latest(buildSuccessRate) AS 'Success %' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild FACET pagesProject SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20
SELECT average(buildDurationMs) AS 'Avg ms' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild FACET pagesProject SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT sum(successBuilds) AS 'Success', sum(failedBuilds) AS 'Failed', sum(cancelledBuilds) AS 'Cancelled' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT sum(failedBuilds) AS 'Failed' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild FACET pagesProject SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT sum(totalBuilds) AS 'Total', sum(successBuilds) AS 'Success', sum(failedBuilds) AS 'Failed' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT average(buildDurationMs) FROM CloudflarePagesBuild FACET pagesProject TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 7 days ago

pages.name: 🚨 Errors & Alerts
pages.description: Worker errors, site errors, build failures — 24hr incident view

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(errors) AS 'Worker Errors' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(errors) / sum(invocations) * 100 AS 'Error %' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(http5xx) AS '5xx' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(http4xx) AS '4xx' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(failedBuilds) AS 'Failed Builds' FROM CloudflarePagesBuild SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Error Logs' FROM Log WHERE logSource = 'cloudflare-worker' AND isError = true SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(errors) FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric FACET workerName TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(http5xx) FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT max(errorRate) AS 'Error %' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric FACET workerName SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 15
SELECT max(errorRate5xx) AS '5xx Rate %' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 10
SELECT timestamp, workerName, appName, level, message, outcome FROM Log WHERE logSource = 'cloudflare-worker' AND isError = true SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 100 ORDER BY timestamp DESC

pages.name: 📦 Platform Usage
pages.description: CF account-level CPU, subrequests, bandwidth, build budget — 24hr / 30 day

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(totalCpuMs) AS 'CPU ms' FROM CloudflareAccountUsage SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(totalSubrequests) AS 'Subrequests' FROM CloudflareAccountUsage SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(totalWorkerRequests) AS 'Worker Requests' FROM CloudflareAccountUsage SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(bytes) / 1000000 AS 'Bandwidth MB' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(totalCpuMs) AS 'CPU ms' FROM CloudflareAccountUsage TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(totalSubrequests) AS 'Subrequests' FROM CloudflareAccountUsage TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT max(cpuTimeP99Ms) AS 'p99ms' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric FACET workerName SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 20
SELECT sum(subrequests) AS 'Subrequests' FROM CloudflareWorkerMetric FACET workerName SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 20
SELECT sum(bytes) / 1000000 AS 'MB' FROM CloudflareSiteMetric FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(totalWorkerRequests) AS 'Requests' FROM CloudflareAccountUsage TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 7 days ago
